mapper.sql: tt1.payment_req_ln_id, tt1.payment_amount, tt1.rate, tt1.actual_payment_amount, tt1.csh_bank_account_id, tt1.csh_bank_account_num, tt1.csh_bank_account_name, tt1.created_by, tt1.creation_date, tt1.last_updated_by, tt1.last_update_date, tt1.last_update_login, tt1.object_version_number, tt1.request_id, tt1.program_id, tt1.csh_bank_id, tt1.payment_name_id, tt1.payment_name, tt1.actual_payment_date, tt1.process_instance_id, tt1.flow_no, tt1.trade_no, tt1.purpose, tt1.apy_number, tt1.csh_bank_branch_name,
mapper.select:
SELECT
(select scvb.meaning from sys_code_value_b scvb , sys_code_b scb where scvb.CODE_ID = scb.CODE_ID and scb.code= 'CSH.PAYMENT_METHOD' and scvb.value = t.payment_method) payment_name_n, t.FUNDING_PLAN_LN_ID,
t.PAYMENT_REQ_ID, nvl(t.DEDUCT_AMOUNT,0) DEDUCT_AMOUNT,
t.SOURCE_DOC_ID, t.SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID, tt2.COMPANY_ID, tt2.document_type, tt2.ACTUAL_PAY_DATE, tt2.CURRENCY, (select ccc.CF_ITEM from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.CASHFLOW_ID=t.SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID) CF_ITEM, (select ccc.CF_type from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.CASHFLOW_ID=t.SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID) CF_type, (select ccc.times from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.CASHFLOW_ID=t.SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID) times, nvl(tt1.CSH_BANK_BRANCH_NAME,tt1.CSH_BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME) CSH_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID_N,
(select f.rival_account_no from hls_itfc_bank_flow f where f.flow_id=tt1.flow_no and rownum = 1) rival_account_no, (select f.rival_account_no from hls_itfc_bank_flow f where f.flow_id=tt1.flow_no and rownum=1) flow_no_n, (select f.rival_account_name from hls_itfc_bank_flow f where f.flow_id=tt1.flow_no and rownum = 1) rival_account_name
FROM csh_pay_req_ln_bank_account tt1, csh_payment_req_ln t, csh_payment_req_hd tt2
tt1.PAYMENT_REQ_LN_ID = t.PAYMENT_REQ_LN_ID and t.PAYMENT_REQ_ID=tt2.PAYMENT_REQ_ID /*and tt1.PAYMENT_NAME = 'TT'*/
and t.PAYMENT_REQ_ID = #{paymentReqId}
and t.PAYMENT_REQ_LN_ID = #{paymentReqLnId}

SELECT
(select scvb.meaning from sys_code_value_b scvb , sys_code_b scb where scvb.CODE_ID = scb.CODE_ID and scb.code= 'CSH.PAYMENT_METHOD' and scvb.value = t.payment_method) payment_name_n, t.FUNDING_PLAN_LN_ID,
t.PAYMENT_REQ_ID, nvl(t.DEDUCT_AMOUNT,0) DEDUCT_AMOUNT,
t.SOURCE_DOC_ID, t.SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID, tt2.COMPANY_ID, tt2.document_type, tt2.ACTUAL_PAY_DATE, tt2.CURRENCY, (select ccc.CF_ITEM from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.CASHFLOW_ID=t.SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID) CF_ITEM, (select ccc.CF_type from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.CASHFLOW_ID=t.SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID) CF_type, (select ccc.times from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.CASHFLOW_ID=t.SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID) times, nvl(tt1.CSH_BANK_BRANCH_NAME,tt1.CSH_BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME) CSH_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID_N,
(select f.rival_account_no from hls_itfc_bank_flow f where f.flow_id=tt1.flow_no and rownum = 1) rival_account_no, (select f.rival_account_no from hls_itfc_bank_flow f where f.flow_id=tt1.flow_no and rownum=1) flow_no_n, (select f.rival_account_name from hls_itfc_bank_flow f where f.flow_id=tt1.flow_no and rownum = 1) rival_account_name
FROM csh_pay_req_ln_bank_account tt1, csh_payment_req_ln t, csh_payment_req_hd tt2
tt1.PAYMENT_REQ_LN_ID = t.PAYMENT_REQ_LN_ID and t.PAYMENT_REQ_ID=tt2.PAYMENT_REQ_ID and tt1.PAYMENT_NAME = 'OTHER'
and t.PAYMENT_REQ_ID = #{paymentReqId}
and t.PAYMENT_REQ_LN_ID = #{paymentReqLnId}

SELECT sum(tt1.ACTUAL_PAYMENT_AMOUNT) ACTUAL_PAYMENT_AMOUNT
FROM csh_pay_req_ln_bank_account tt1, csh_payment_req_ln t, csh_payment_req_hd tt2
tt1.PAYMENT_REQ_LN_ID = t.PAYMENT_REQ_LN_ID and t.PAYMENT_REQ_ID=tt2.PAYMENT_REQ_ID
and t.PAYMENT_REQ_ID = #{paymentReqId}

select pa.*, l.SOURCE_DOC_ID, l.SOURCE_DOC_LINE_ID from con_contract c, csh_pay_req_ln_bank_account pa, csh_payment_req_ln l, csh_payment_req_hd h
c.contract_id = l.source_doc_id and h.payment_req_id = l.payment_req_id and (l.payment_req_id = pa.payment_req_id or l.payment_req_ln_id=pa.payment_req_ln_id) and h.payment_req_status = 'APPROVED' -- and h.payment_approved_status = 'PAID' and c.contract_id=#{contractId}

SELECT sum(prlba.ACTUAL_PAYMENT_AMOUNT) refund_payment_amount FROM csh_pay_req_ln_bank_account prlba
prlba.refund_id = #{refundId}
